paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the training and validation accuracy of a model over a series of epochs. The x-axis is labeled "Epoch" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with numeric tick labels spaced evenly every 5 units. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and employs a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 10 units. There are two solid lines on the plot, neither of which use marker shapes. The "Train" line is depicted in dark blue and begins at approximately 46% at epoch 0. It fluctuates between 45% and 69% until epoch 11, where it hits a low of roughly 45%, before embarking on a sharp upward trend. This rise includes a peak at approximately 91% at epoch 19, followed by a brief decline to roughly 83% at epoch 20, after which it steadily climbs to plateau at nearly 100% from epoch 25 through the final value at epoch 29. The "Validation" line, shown in dark green, starts at roughly 45% at epoch 0 and mirrors the general fluctuations of the Train line at lower values. It reaches an early low of approximately 42% at epoch 11 and a local high of about 62% at epoch 7. After epoch 14, the Validation line trends upward to reach roughly 72% at epoch 19, drops to approximately 66% at epoch 20, and then continues climbing to finish at a final value of approximately 82.5% at epoch 29.
